branch.description: Branch to release from. Defaults to the CI default branch, then "main".

cliff-config.description: Path to the git-cliff config. Defaults to git-cliff's own discovery.

pull-request-title.description: Title of the release request (single line). Placeholders: ${tags}, ${version}.

pull-request-body.description: Body template of the release request; must contain ${notes} exactly once. Placeholders: ${tags}, ${version}, ${releases}, ${hint}, ${release}, ${notes}.

release-commit-message.description: Message of the release commit (may span several lines). Defaults to the request title. Placeholders: ${tags}, ${version}.

release-name.description: Title template of the created releases. Placeholders: ${tag}, ${version}, ${component}.

tag-template.description: Tag format. Must contain ${version} exactly once and may contain ${component} once.

labels.description: Labels used to track release requests.

pending.description: Label of open release requests ("relwolf: pending").

tagged.description: Label of merged and tagged release requests ("relwolf: tagged").

draft.description: Open the release request as draft.

release-emoji.description: Prefix the default release title with a random emoji.

no-changes-text.default: No changes, version bumped to stay in sync.
no-changes-text.description: Text for packages that were only released to follow linked packages; empty to add nothing.

assignees.description: Usernames assigned when the release request is created.

reviewers.description: Usernames requested as reviewers when the request is created.

patch-types.description: Commit types that trigger a patch release.

minor-types.description: Commit types that trigger a minor release. Breaking changes always trigger a major release.

exclude-paths.description: Globs from the repository root whose changes never count.

bootstrap-sha.description: History up to and including this commit is ignored for packages without a release tag.

separate-pull-requests.description: Create one release request per package or linked group.

linked-versions.description: true: all packages share one version; or a list of groups of package paths that share one.

linked-tags.description: per-package: every package gets its own tag; single: one tag and release per linked group.

prerelease.description: Pre-release identifier for all packages, e.g. "beta".

bump-minor-pre-major.description: Breaking changes only bump the minor version before 1.0.0 (default for all packages).

packages.description: Packages by path relative to the repository root ("." for the root).

component.description: Tag prefix of the package. Optional for a single package, required for every other package.

changelog-path.description: Changelog file, relative to the package path.

updaters.description: Files in which the version is updated.

path.description: File to update, relative to the package path. Defaults to the usual file of the type; required for json, yaml, toml and generic.

key.description: Dotted key path of the version (json, yaml and toml updaters).

lockfiles.description: Also update the lockfiles next to the manifest.

prerelease.description: Pre-release identifier of this package, e.g. "beta".

bump-minor-pre-major.description: Breaking changes only bump the minor version before 1.0.0 (overrides the global value).

initial-version.description: First stable version if the package has no release tag yet.
